svg.aria-label: Left: a sine of amplitude X = 2 passes through a saturation with S = 1; the output (blue) is a clipped sine. Its fundamental harmonic (pink dashed) has amplitude Y1 = 1.22, in phase with the input. Right: the harmonic content of the output; only odd harmonics appear and the third is already small
